text: Adopt daily/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl as the canonical daily path across all machines; do not create a YYYY/ subdirectory layer.
Keep daily entries lightweight - one line per tag - so appending is fast and reading is scannable.
The primary repo is writable; all reference repos stay read-only.
Prefer dense entry style in daily notes to minimise file churn.
Decide whether to keep or delete the old memory/2026/2026-04-13.md style path after migration is confirmed.
